summary: All 10 online boxes independently re-verified in the same Quake 1 deathmatch at once: the server roster named Fleet110/123/124/133/143/171/184/186/240/243 (no bots), each box sent 529-856 packets to :26000 in 12 s, and frames showed e1m1 in-game on the 8 GL boxes (.186 and .243 frames black as expected). The game was then closed on every box; PROCLIST shows no glquake/winquake left.
issues: GLQuake/WinQuake ignore WM_CLOSE: lanparty kill had to force-terminate on all 9 XP/Win7 boxes after 12 s (.243 killed via its path). No crash dialogs were seen afterwards.

.186 had a Windows Security Alert (Win7 firewall prompt from winquake.exe) left in the foreground after the close; dismissed with ESCAPE, so the foreground is now the agent console. A future WinQuake round there will raise it again unless the firewall exception exists.
Desktop mode after the forced close was not measured per box (DISPLAYCFG not run); the foreground on every NT box is the agent console or retro_chat, with no game window left.
